## Description

Common trigger shape: a `SHAPE_REPRESENTATION` whose `items` list is empty (`()`) combined with a dangling product chain — a `PRODUCT_DEFINITION_SHAPE` with no `SHAPE_DEFINITION_REPRESENTATION` linking it back to any representation. Producer signature: STEP/IGES emitted by a particular Rhino-6 build, which exposes the receiver's missing bound-check.
